tips.text: Solve the Archarbor every time it is up; it has the best odds and always the same layout.
Take a Decree before extracting; progress and drops save only up to your last Decree.
Farm in a squad of four so the multiplayer Enigmas unlock and puzzles are found faster.
Learn the fixed Enigma spawn spots from a community Duviri map and sweep them.
Expect duplicates; every solve rolls one random piece with no pity, and the last piece can take hours.
Buy Enigma Sense before you farm; it waypoints nearby Enigmas.
If the Archarbor loads with nothing lit, warp to a distant Materlith, do a side objective and warp back.
Expect two-player Enigmas to fail often with randoms who do not know the mechanic.
Opinion splits hard: many call it one of the worst weapon farms, others say it is fast once the Archarbor routine is learned.
Finding puzzles was the main complaint before Enigma Sense; the drop odds are the complaint now.
